name: race
title: Race
description: Race a task on several agents of one profile at once, such as four of a small local model, each in a git worktree of its own. They share a board where they post what they learn, read each other's work and borrow what helps, and run your check before they finish. They can rank each other's work; then the conversation that started the race merges the best, or combines the best parts.
tagline: Several agents race one task, each in a worktree of its own, sharing a board; the best work gets merged.
